_note: C2 sizing outputs for D1 (wing CAD) and D3/D7 where marked. Written by team/C2/wing_struct.py. Frame: params.json#frame, metres. Status PROPOSED until D1 models it and H1 proof-tests it.

spar.tube: CF 22 x 20 x 1000 mm, roll-wrapped, unspliced
spar.slot: 22.4 mm wide (0.2 mm per side bond line), cut from the lower surface to z_s + 11.2 mm, bottom rounded r 11.2 mm; slot foam strip re-bonded as the cap
spar.bond: 30-min epoxy + glass microballoons (1:1 by volume), full wet-out of the slot; cure 24 h before tape
spar.abrade: sand the tube 120 grit, wipe with IPA

plugs.what: internal plug, printed PETG 19.8 mm dia x 36 mm, 4 perimeters 50 % gyroid, bonded with thickened epoxy
plugs.why: spar wall ring bending under the through-core block bore (CR-C4-02)
plugs.install: push in from the spar end with a marked dowel to |y| = 0.32 m before the spar goes into the slot

anchor_plugs.what: printed PETG plug 19.8 mm dia x 20 mm, 30 % fill, bonded
anchor_plugs.per_anchor: one under each brace saddle, upper and lower braces share it (|y| 0.242)
anchor_plugs.why: ring bending under the 146 N design saddle load exceeds the hoop allowable without it
anchor_plugs.order: push the anchor plug (0.242) in first, then the block plug (0.32)

skin.layup: 1 layer packing tape each side, spanwise strips, 10 % overlap, wrapped 15 mm round the LE; tape continuous over the spar slot and the block pockets
skin.required_for: chordwise bending aft of the spar (bare foam MS < tape MS), torsion cell, handling
skin.doublers: one extra chordwise tape band 60 mm wide over each block pocket and each servo pocket edge

core.ribs: none: the core is the rib; the blocks FIN-004-L/R are the hard points at |y| 0.32
core.pockets: block pocket full depth at |y| 0.32 (C4/D3 size), brace anchor pockets 20 x 16 mm to the spar at |y| 0.242, servo pockets aft of x 0.12 m only
core.keep_out: no cut deeper than 50 % of the local thickness between x 0.06 and 0.10 m except the spar slot and block pockets
core.pocket_corners: C2-R2 3-D FEA (CR-C2-11): block pocket vertical edges R 3 mm (block edges rounded or chamfered 3 mm to match, D3) plus a thickened-epoxy fillet bead >= 3 mm along the inboard and outboard pocket edges on both surfaces; foam peak at the sharp corner 203 kPa tension / 199 kPa compression ult vs 150 / 120 kPa
core.elevon_cutout_corners: R >= 3 mm where the elevon cut-outs meet the fin-root tab (|y| 0.30, 0.34) at the hinge line; tape carried round the cut-out edge (CR-C2-13)

tip.edge: wingtip edge tape 2 layers (damage fuse; L6 tip strike breaks the tip outboard of the spar, repair = re-cut and glue)

pod.bond: epoxy to bare foam (remove tape in the footprint, sand); not onto tape
